lines.text: Shiva once gave a demon the power to burn anyone to ash, with one touch. The demon tried it on Shiva first.

parts.text: Shiva once gave a demon the power to burn anyone to ash, with one touch.
The demon tried it on Shiva first.

lines.text: Bhasmasura prayed for years. Pleased, Shiva offered him any boon.

parts.text: Pleased, Shiva offered him any boon.

lines.text: Let whoever I touch on the head burn to ash.

parts.text: Let whoever I touch on the head burn to ash.

lines.text: Granted. And his hand reached straight for Shiva.

parts.text: And his hand reached straight for Shiva.

lines.text: Shiva ran. Vishnu saw it, and became Mohini. The most beautiful dancer in all the worlds.

parts.text: Vishnu saw it, and became Mohini.
The most beautiful dancer in all the worlds.

lines.text: Dance with me. Copy every move.
Hand on hip. Hand on shoulder. Hand on head.
The power you beg for can be the thing that ends you. Ask wisely.
